Professional Summary
Backend-focused Node.js developer with hands-on experience building scalable APIs and services. Proven track record delivering production features, improving API performance, and maintaining data integrity across microservices. Open to relocating to Kolkata or Mumbai. Notice period: 30 days.

Node.js, TS, Express.js, MongoDB, GraphQL, Docker, Git, Agile

- Led deployment of a Node.js microservice in Docker containers to staging and production, streamlining rollbacks and decreasing deployment time by 40% under Agile sprint cycles.

Backend Engineer, Zentrix Labs (Sep 2024 - Oct 2025)
- Developed and optimized Express.js APIs backed by MongoDB for analytics ingestion, increasing throughput by 3x and reducing write contention via index and schema changes.
- Migrated legacy endpoints to new Express.js routes with pagination and aggregation pipelines in MongoDB, enabling more efficient reporting and lowering query costs.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints, used Git for code reviews, and containerized services to standardize development environments.

Node.js Developer, Nykaa (Mar 2022 - Aug 2024)
- Built Dockerized Node.js services and GraphQL endpoints for catalog and recommendation systems, improving feature rollout velocity and enabling A/B testing.
- Implemented server-side batching and caching in GraphQL resolvers to reduce downstream calls and cut median response time by 25%.
- Maintained CI workflows with Git, participated in Agile ceremonies, and contributed to incident responses to improve service reliability.
